ops.title: Index ledger rows during fold to remove quadratic upsert searches
ops.description: Owner /root/ccn_ledger_fold_perf. Deadline Nov2 03:00Pacific/11:00UTC. Confirmed source: fold_ledger.go upsert performs rowIndex for every historical UpsertRow; N distinct inserts cause quadratic comparisons. Private row-key index preserves field merge/replace, sorting, stable removals, duplicate-checkpoint first-match and seed ownership/history replay. Next: exact-source review and hosted immutable old/new N32/N10000 plus selected-ledger-history costs, then independent normal release/install/affected-case verification. Warm full-snapshot clone/sort remains proportional to selected ledger size.
